archReview.notes: RVV 1.0 / Zve32f e32,m4 intrinsics only (vsetvl_e32m4, vle32/vse32, vlse32/vsse32, vfadd_vv_f32m4); no x86/ARM or th.v*. vtype SEW=32/LMUL=4 consistent across all vector ops; runtime vl = min(AVL=n-i, VLMAX) so VLEN-independent (VLEN=128, VLMAX m4=16). No mask; tail handled by runtime vl with ta,ma, only vl lanes stored (no OOB tail write). Peak live m4 groups ~2 (vc, vd/result), no spill. Strided store correctly uses __riscv_vsse32 (vsse32.v) not unit-stride vse32; confirmed by disassembly. RVV path guarded by MXNET_IM2COL_USE_RVV and std::is_same<DType,float>, scalar fallback intact. Evidence: diaglog Build ISA contains v1p0_..._zve32f1p0_..._zvl128b1p0; hardware ISA rv64imafdcv_..._zve32f; blueprint targetHardware 'SOPHGO SG2044 / XuanTie C920v2'.

findings.suggestion: The float dispatch uses a runtime-constant if rather than if constexpr, so for non-float DType the RVV body is still instantiated (dead but compilable). Optional: switch to if constexpr; however the pre-existing im2col_copy_strided_row in the same header uses the identical idiom, so keeping it is consistent. No correctness impact.
